name: NEXTDC A1 Adelaide
notes: Official NEXTDC specification lists A1 at 125 Frome Street in Adelaide CBD with 5MW planned/critical power and Tier IV/fault-tolerant positioning; current NEXTDC page says the Adelaide facility has opened.

name: Equinix AE1 Adelaide
notes: Official Equinix Adelaide page lists AE1 as its Adelaide data centre location with colocation services and global certifications.

name: Colocity DC1 Pulteney Street
notes: Official Colocity page says it operates two centrally located Adelaide CBD data centres; DC1 is the original Pulteney Street site, opened in 2007 with Tier-2 level redundancy and about 100 square metres of technical space.

name: Colocity DC3 Morphett Street
notes: Official Colocity page describes DC3 as a Morphett Street Adelaide CBD data centre with Tier-3 level redundancy; the site opened in 2015 after building and power/cooling upgrades.
